semiconductor_relevance: High — YGK specializes in particle inspection systems for un-patterned wafers, which are critical for quality assurance in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: YGK provides advanced particle inspection systems designed for un-patterned wafers, including the Lab Particle Scan and YPI-series tools. These systems are utilized for process monitoring, wafer cleaning confirmation, and outgoing inspection in semiconductor fabs and manufacturers.
capabilities: Lab Particle Scan for un-patterned wafer inspection
YPI-series for surface particle and scratch inspection
YPI-MX series for various material and wafer size inspections
